case.subject: The overprepared picnic planner
case.problem: A fictional group keeps losing track of who is bringing what to a picnic.
case.workflow: Ask Claude to draft a small checklist from synthetic names and items. Add a duplicate-item warning and an unassigned-item list. Manually check every assignment and one deliberate duplicate. Do not connect apps or send invitations.
case.result: Proposed demonstration, not a measured customer result.
case.result_basis: Vendor-documented artifact capability; fictional untested scenario.
case.measurement_context: No measured time savings or personal hands-on result claimed.
case.source_quote: Claude can make an artifact out of almost anything, including documents, code snippets, single-page websites
case.limitation: Evergreen capability checked today, not a new launch. Generated logic can be wrong; use synthetic data and inspect results. Account capabilities vary.
case.listener_action: Try a fictional five-person checklist and deliberately duplicate one item to test the output.
case.availability: Artifacts require code execution/file creation enabled; verify account capabilities. Sharing is optional and not part of this demonstration.
